body:
on this day in 2022: HAIM's sold-out show at London's O2 Arena, and she just... walks out.

"i heard that my girls were playing in london at the O2 and i thought, 'i'm gonna have to see that.' and it looks like there's about 20,000 other people that also thought that, too."

she and the sisters — who opened her entire 1989 World Tour back in 2015 — tore into a Gasoline/Love Story mashup, her in the same custom Louis Vuitton trousers HAIM had worn all tour. her verdict on being back on a stage: "it's nice... it's very nice."

no album, no announcement. just a surprise reunion on a random Thursday in July.
